title: IELTS Vocabulary Practice - IELTS Vocabulary - Collocations
subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: It is essential to ______ attention to the details when writing your essay.
questions.explain: The correct collocation is 'pay attention'. 'Give attention' is possible but usually requires an object (e.g., 'give attention to someone'), whereas 'pay attention' is the standard phrase for focusing.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: She decided to ______ a course in digital marketing to improve her skills.
questions.explain: The standard collocation is to 'take a course' (or do a course).
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: We need to ______ a compromise if we want to move forward.
questions.explain: The standard collocation is to 'reach a compromise' (or 'come to a compromise').
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: I would like to ______ an apology for my behavior yesterday.
questions.explain: The correct collocation is to 'make an apology'.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: It is important to ______ into account the environmental impact of the project.
questions.explain: The set phrase is 'take into account', meaning to consider.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary
